environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'media-processing' behind AWS ALB ingress controller v2.6.1. ALB target group configured with gRPC protocol version. Ingress resource annotated with alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-type: cognito AND separate NLB listener on port 8443 with TLS policy requiring mutual authentication (aws_lb_listener_certificate with client CA bundle from ACM PCA subordinate CA arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:ACCOUNT:certificate-authority/abc123). The NLB TLS listener has 'mutual_authentication' block with mode='verify' and trust_store_arn pointing to the internal PKI trust store. Pod SecurityContext sets readOnlyRootFilesystem: true with emptyDir at /var/data/uploads (non-hostPath). Additionally, Kubernetes NetworkPolicy allows ingress ONLY from aws-load-balancer-controller pods on port 8443.
